On the colour and plain zoom-3 crops, the 'upper' fan (19050-19167, v 73-107) and the 'lower' ellipse (19113-19247, v 103-150) both converge on one hub: a small dark knob at 19107-19117, v 95-102. So this is one tilted parasol whose hub sits off-centre, as on S3.prop.tilted_parasol_19790, and the base moves from u 19160 (under the canopy's middle, est) to under the pole, u 19105 (est, v unchanged). t7's frame awning (S3.prop.frame_awning_19070, the middle agent's) gives an east post at u ~19103, v 100-140, which is this same stroke. Its long diagonal from (19010, 60) toward (19110, 98) ends at this hub. The lead decides whether that frame is a separate thing. Support (deck or far bank) is unchanged.
